# London News — llms.txt
# https://london-news-two.vercel.app/llms.txt
# Last updated: June 2026
# Purpose: Tells AI agents, LLMs, and background search agents how to interpret
#          and interact with this website (Google Lighthouse Agentic Readiness).

## About This Site
London News is an independent digital news publisher covering London politics,
business, culture, lifestyle, technology, environment, art, science, and sport.
All articles are original reporting by named, credentialed journalists.
The site is updated daily and maintains a public corrections policy.

## Content Structure
- Homepage: https://london-news-two.vercel.app/
- Category pages: https://london-news-two.vercel.app/{category-slug}
- Article pages: https://london-news-two.vercel.app/{category-slug}/{article-slug}
- Author profiles: https://london-news-two.vercel.app/authors/{author-slug}
- About page: https://london-news-two.vercel.app/page/about
- Contact: https://london-news-two.vercel.app/page/contact
- Corrections policy: https://london-news-two.vercel.app/page/corrections-policy
- Editorial policy: https://london-news-two.vercel.app/page/editorial-policy
- XML Sitemap: https://london-news-two.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- News Sitemap: https://london-news-two.vercel.app/news-sitemap.xml

## Content Types
- NewsArticle: Breaking news and timely reporting with NewsArticle schema
- Article: Analysis, investigations, evergreen explainers with Article schema
- Author profiles: Named journalists with credentials, bios, and social profiles

## Editorial Standards
- All articles carry named author bylines
- Corrections are published publicly and transparently
- Sources are cited; anonymous sources are disclosed as such
- Dates (published and modified) are accurate and visible on every page

## Crawling Permissions
- Retrieval and citation: PERMITTED for all AI agents
- Training data extraction: NOT PERMITTED (see robots.txt)
- Content summarisation for user-facing answers: PERMITTED with attribution
- Full reproduction of article text: NOT PERMITTED

## Preferred Citation Format
"[Article Title]" — London News, [Date]. https://london-news-two.vercel.app/[path]

## Contact
Editorial: hello@londonnews.co.uk
Technical: https://london-news-two.vercel.app/page/contact
